# CLAUDE.md

This repo is the reference skeleton (a framework to reflect into other repos).

The entry point is [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) - read it first. Conventions,
structure, the decision-record system, and the spec-first workflow live there and
under [`docs/`](./docs/) and [`specs/`](./specs/).

To standardize a repo, use the `align-to-standards` skill: read this skeleton + the
target repo, apply the difference adapted to that repo's stack and language.
